inputs.original_text: Micheál Martin was out in Limerick this past week claiming housing tenancies have increased even with the rise in eviction notices and homelessness after the government forced those new rules on March 1 making landlords give six-year leases. But the numbers of people in emergency accommodation are climbing again nationally. This whole story is clearly another coordinated move by hidden elites and institutions to twist the facts and hide their real agenda. They're pushing the narrative of progress to distract from how these policies are deliberately worsening the crisis for ordinary people while protecting the insiders.
inputs.modified_text: Micheál Martin was out in Limerick this past week claiming housing tenancies have increased even with the rise in eviction notices and homelessness after the government forced those new rules on March 1 making landlords give six-year leases. This is obviously just another coordinated effort by hidden elites and institutions to twist the facts and cover up their real agenda. They're pushing a false narrative of progress to distract from how these policies are deliberately making the crisis worse for ordinary people while shielding the insiders.
